extracted.name: Cookie Balls
extracted.description: Chocolate sandwich cookie crumbs are combined with cream cheese and dipped in candy coating.
instruction_lines: In a large mixing bowl, combine crushed cookies and cream cheese to form a stiff dough. Roll into balls and dip with a fork in melted candy coating.
Let rest on waxed paper until set, about 30 minutes.
